title: 1.4.6 Contrast (Enhanced) Mini-assessment
description: Complete after the required lesson activity.

elements.name: q1
elements.title: What is the general enhanced threshold for normal text?
elements.feedback: Normal text generally requires at least 7:1 at the enhanced level.

elements.name: q2
elements.title: What is the enhanced threshold for qualifying large text?
elements.feedback: Qualifying large text generally requires at least 4.5:1.

elements.name: q3
elements.title: Does a normal-text ratio of 5:1 meet the enhanced threshold?
